design.choice: SeparableReport::box_transform: Option<BoxTransform> (Some on the periodic box, None on a sphere grid), written by SeparableStages::client from the kernel it builds; BoxTransform derives Serialize (kebab case: complex, paired-real)
why: The client id of DriverWork::SeparableClient is the constant SEPARABLE_STAGE_CLIENT_ID written in crates/vigilode/src/solve.rs:530, outside this task's paths; a constant cannot depend on the run, so a second client id needs a solve.rs edit.
The SeparableReport is the only per-run value that separable.rs hands to a Solution (StageLinearSystem has no identifier; the driver's client is dropped).
Decision KS-N7-T and the KS-N7 protocol name the report first; the report is typed; the client id keeps naming the client (same certificates for both transforms).

api_change.semver_tool: cargo-semver-checks not installed (env.txt); public-API changes reviewed by hand from logs/public_api_diff.log
api_change.major: SeparableReport gains the public field box_transform (all fields public, not non_exhaustive): downstream struct literals that list every field, and exhaustive destructuring patterns, stop compiling; literals with ..Default::default() keep compiling (the field defaults to None). The type was added at a0ec98ba on this research branch and is unreleased (not on main); the workspace has no such literal or pattern.
api_change.behavior: BoxTransform::default() is PairedReal instead of Complex: a box built without with_box_transform runs the paired transform (same linear map, different rounding; K17 bounds the difference). The serialized run record gains the key report.box_transform.
api_change.unchanged: No item removed or renamed; no signature changed; crates/vigilode/src/spatial.rs exports unchanged; SEPARABLE_STAGE_CLIENT_ID unchanged.
diff_lines: -#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
+#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize)]

design.alternative_left_open: A non-breaking second client id for the paired box solve: a const and a getter in separable.rs plus solve.rs:530 writing stages.client_id(); it can be added to the report field or replace it (orchestrator's choice; solve.rs is outside this task's paths).
